properties.name: mask
properties.comment: The mask (Mask); a view onto the provider. A new mask keeps as much of the text as it takes (the assigned characters, without prompts or literals, placed again from the first position), or starts empty, and raises mask_changed. Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid mask (MaskedTextProvider).
hand: a view onto provider_: write_view replaces the provider with this box's settings, keeps what text it can and raises mask_changed

properties.name: culture
properties.comment: The culture whose separators and currency symbol the mask's placeholders show (Culture); a view onto the provider. A change keeps as much of the text as the mask takes.
hand: a view onto provider_: write_view replaces the provider and keeps what text it can

properties.name: text
properties.comment: The text in text_mask_format (Text); a view onto the provider (under an empty mask, the editor's text). A write clears the box and places the text from the first position, literals in it matching the mask's literals, as place_text does; refused text leaves the box unchanged and raises mask_input_rejected instead of throwing (place_text reports the result). A placed text raises text_changed.
hand: a view onto provider_: read_view is the text in text_mask_format; write_view runs place_text and drops its result

properties.name: text_mask_format
properties.comment: What text includes (TextMaskFormat): literals, prompts, both or neither. A change raises text_changed when text changes; an unknown format throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare refuses an unknown format; written publishes the text if it changed

properties.name: prompt_character
properties.comment: The character shown in each unassigned position (PromptChar); a view onto the provider, which refuses an unusable character (std::invalid_argument).
hand: a view onto provider_: write_view redisplays the provider

properties.name: allow_prompt_as_input
properties.comment: Whether the prompt character is accepted as input (AllowPromptAsInput); a view onto the provider.

properties.name: ascii_only
properties.comment: Whether letter positions take only ASCII letters (AsciiOnly); a view onto the provider.

properties.name: skip_literals
properties.comment: Whether input matching a literal passes over it (SkipLiterals); a view onto the provider.

properties.name: reset_on_prompt
properties.comment: Whether typing the prompt character clears the position (ResetOnPrompt); a view onto the provider.

properties.name: reset_on_space
properties.comment: Whether typing a space clears the position (ResetOnSpace); a view onto the provider.

properties.name: reject_input_on_first_failure
properties.comment: With it off (the default), a paste keeps the characters the mask takes and reports each one it drops; with it on, one refused character refuses the whole paste (RejectInputOnFirstFailure).

properties.name: overwrite_mode
properties.comment: Typing overwrites the character at the caret instead of inserting before it (IsOverwriteMode). The Insert key toggles it. A change raises overwrite_mode_changed.

properties.name: read_only
properties.comment: Whether the user may select and copy the text but not change it (ReadOnly); the editor follows.
hand: written sets the editor's read_only and invalidates paint and semantics

not_properties.name: place_text
not_properties.reason: reports a MaskEditResult and raises mask_input_rejected instead of throwing: an expected alternative; the text property's write runs it and drops the result (GAPS E5)
